plotSections.title: Ord sees the invisible boat
bullets: Ord casts See Invisibility and can finally see the invisible party on the muted boat.
He sees Gerk half dazed on the deck wrestling with Sylan near the closed floating spectral door.
Dana stands nearby looking concerned and confused.
Two crew members, including the helmsman, wander the deck bumping into each other and silently trying to call out.
All interactions remain soundless despite visible movement.

plotSections.title: Fading doorway impression
bullets: Where Gerk opened the portal, Ord sees faint glowing lines at the edges that fade faster with each blink.
By the time Ord reaches them they are down to about fifteen or sixteen percent opacity.
Inside the fading frame he briefly sees ghostly watercolor-like figures passing as if through a side street in a city.
The vision smudges into nothing as the impression fades into the ether.

plotSections.title: Ord calms the wrestling match
bullets: Ord investigates the fading portal lines, then tries to steady Sylan and Gerk without restraining them.
His persuasion check of 15 is solid enough that Sylan and Gerk notice his oily silhouette placing a hand on both of them.

plotSections.title: Blind Eye Speech and the spectral door
bullets: Sylan uses a token of blind eye speech to whisper with Ord, confirming Ord can see them through See Invisibility.
Sylan asks Gerk what he did; Gerk replies that he opened the door.
The spectral door still floats over and slightly behind Gerk, resembling his shield-door but more functional and without a frame.
It appears fully shut with no visible portal beyond it.
Sylan urges Gerk as Doorman to investigate the door, and Gerk agrees.

chronologicalEvents: Ord casts See Invisibility while covered in oil.
Ord sees Gerk and Sylan wrestling near the closed spectral door, with Dana and confused crew nearby in silent motion.
Ord notices fading glowing lines and ghostly city figures where Gerk opened the portal.
Ord moves to the fading lines, but they are nearly gone by the time he arrives.
Ord steadies Sylan and Gerk with a persuasion check of 15.
Sylan and Gerk see Ord’s oily silhouette touch them.
Sylan uses a token of blind eye speech to whisper with Ord.
Sylan asks Gerk what happened; Gerk says he opened the door.
Gerk confirms he can see the shut floating spectral door behind him.
Gerk agrees to investigate the door as Doorman.
